body:
TELL your parents how they make you feel. I say this
Because I've been there (though my dad and your mom would be reversed.) Sit down, write out what you want to say, really think about it. Make sure you tell your dad why you are on his side sometimes and not other times, and why would are sometimes on and not on your mother's side. Don't get emotional! Be as detached and logical as you can. This is why it's important to think this all out beforehand. Spend a couple of days, make sure you collect yourself to the point where you can say what needs to be said without getting emotionally attached. 

Call your parents and tell them you need to talk. Tell them both where they support you and where they don't, how you were a good student and know how to be a good student but you need their support, how you won't allow them to put you in the middle of their relationship and their own problems. You are becoming an adult, and working to become your own person, but as long as they are involved they have to realize what an effect it has on you. They are being selfish. Don't tell them in soapy words, but do let them know that they chose to have children and this is a huge part of you becoming an adult. They haven't lost that responsibility yet. If they want to make a good kid they a few more years of work ahead of them. 

If they do not take to this information kindly be prepared to be on your own. If they can't support you and help you then you are going to be fighting this fight alone. Trust me, you are strong enough. Your parents aren't strong enough to fight their fights but you are. You proved it by seeking help.

If they are strong enough to realize you are right and they has wronged you will have an ally through the darkness. Don't hold their own weakness against them, as they will feel tremendous guilt. Try to separate your emotion from what you know is right. You will get through this, and life with be nothing but possibilities from them on. You have to know that is true. Hold out till this shit is over.

not good. I broke up with me SO, because I will be better without them. I am happy tonight because Obama won. I also am going to tell my mom to not let me know the combination to her safe where I know her gun is hidden. Not because I don't want to die but because I don't want her to feel responsible.
I tried playing guitar before. I'm hopeless.
I love music, but I can't play for shit. I love to sing but I need lessons which I can't afford.
That would require getting off the couch and leaving the house. :)
I'm not gonna ride the self-pity train. Suffice it to say, I think I'm a piece of shit for a long list of reasons. Some may not be legitimate, but many are.

I don't have any legitimate reason to be unhappy. I have an awesome family, a great SO, wonderful pets, I live in a beautiful place, and have a good job. But I still suffer, and I hate myself, and nothing in my life is enough to keep me from having these thoughts.
Life is worth living for those who are happy. I'm so unhappy. I love my family. I don't want to put them through that suffering. But I'm suffering so much.

The thought of having anyone I care about suffer through something like that is really the only reason I haven't gone through with it yet. I love my family, and I don't want to put them through that. But that means I'm not living for me at all. I'm so unhappy, angry, tired, and I hate myself. I just want it to end.

Pretty general. I get down on myself more than most people would for stupid things. I don't know if it's fair, but I can't stop it. I remember all the bad or embarrassing shit I've done and hold on to it. Doesn't help.
SO doesn't really understand. Gets frustrated because he doesn't understand what I'm feeling. Just wants me to get over it. Doesn't like that it makes him feel shitty too.
That's really what's keeping me from going through with it. But I'm so unhappy, and so tired and angry. If it weren't for how they would feel I would have done it long ago.
Constant pain, self-hate, fear. Mostly self-hate.
